optics.lens: Opto Engineering RT-V1228-MPY2; Computar V1228-MPY2 reference

notes: Selected validation labels retain the original 100 x 44 mm short-code case; 200/250 mm and longer encodings are comparison cases, not mandated warehouse relabelling.
110 g lens allocation exceeds the archived manufacturer datasheet's 102.8 g; 97 g later brochure mass is not used.
20 g battery uplift and 20 g extra pitch-support mass are engineering allocations, not manufacturer masses.
Nameplate Li-ion energy is not accepted as delivered energy above the loaded cutoff. Nominal cell voltage is 3.6 V, even if the pack marketing says 22.2 V.
All retry cases retain the full local brake/recenter overhead; no unmeasured recovery success rate is assumed.
Opto Engineering currently catalogues RT-V1228-MPY2 at97g; allocation remains110g to cover the heavier archived specification and installation. Catalogue listing is not stock confirmation.
